description: This file provides Spanish (Ecuador) culture-specific settings for date parsing and formatting using the Datejs library. It includes localization of day and month names, date formats, regex patterns for date components, and prototype extensions for date manipulation.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a Date object to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current local time.
